The NOTE presses into Center intake belt by up to 8 mm, its planning limit. Preliminary geometric assumptions authorized for this review. The belt limit is a rounded 8 mm one-sided indentation, roughly 16% of the 50.8 mm unloaded NOTE section diameter. Separate planning limits apply to the named treads, soft pad and guiding surfaces. No measured allowable or contact force is claimed.
